marks.gloss_en: 'with you' of vehityatzvu is because of the Shekhina, and teaches no count
'with you' of venas'u itach: and you among them -- Moshe joins the seventy, hence seventy-one
similar-to-you follows from 'so shall they make it easier for you, and bear with you' (said of the small courts at Yitro), leaving venas'u itach free for the count
